name: Rice Snow-Balls
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Wash two teacupfuls of rice and boil it in one teacupful of water and one of milk, with a little salt
If the rice is not tender when the milk and water are absorbed, add a little more milk and water
When the rice is tender, flavor with vanilla
Form it into balls, or mold it into a compact form with little cups
Place these rice balls around the inside of a deep dish
Fill the dish with a rich soft custard flavored the same way

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash two teacupfuls of rice and boil it in one teacupful of water and one of milk, with a little salt
2. If the rice is not tender when the milk and water are absorbed, add a little more milk and water
3. When the rice is tender, flavor with vanilla
4. Form it into balls, or mold it into a compact form with little cups
5. Place these rice balls around the inside of a deep dish
6. Fill the dish with a rich soft custard flavored the same way
7. Serve either hot or cold
